summary.tldr: Requires provinces to set and publish health care accountability frameworks to qualify for full Canada Health Transfer cash contributions.
what_it_does: Requires provinces to develop and implement an accountability framework for health services to qualify for a full cash contribution under the Canada Health Transfer.
Requires the framework to set benchmarks for timely access to primary care, elective procedures and emergency care.
Requires the framework to include public reporting on whether the benchmarks are met and on the efficiency of health care spending.
Requires provinces to publish the framework and an annual report on a publicly available website, and to review and update the benchmarks over time.
Allows the federal government to reduce or withhold cash contributions if a province does not meet the new accountability requirements, and to restore them if the problem continues.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Health Act. It ties a province’s full cash contribution to new accountability rules for health service delivery.
